name: Message Passing Neural Networks (generic MPNN/GCN/GIN/GAT)
q1_graph: Message fn + permutation-invariant aggregation + update over the given input graph, K layers
q2_edges: Fixed input graph; GAT adds state-conditioned soft weights on existing edges only
q7_scaling: GCN linear in edges; depth x width must exceed poly(n) for many problems (CONGEST lower bound)
q8_stability: Oversmoothing (exponential, incl. attention), over-squashing; depth does not fix over-squashing
q9_capacity: Expressivity capped at 1-WL; per-node width bounds information flow
q10_more_iterations_help: Not applicable (fixed depth); more layers degrade (oversmoothing/vanishing gradients)
q11_gpu: PyG gather/scatter; ~37% cache hit on sparse aggregation; memory-bound
q12_repos: PyG MIT, DGL Apache-2.0, jraph archived
q13_best_results: FA last layer cuts QM9 error 42% (same model)
q14_unexplored: Whether a weight-tied MPNN on a learned graph beats looped transformers at matched params/FLOPs: not found in our search

name: Gated Graph Neural Networks (GG-NN)
q1_graph: GRU node update over fixed graph, unrolled T steps
q8_stability: Original GNN needed contraction maps for convergence, limiting long-range propagation; GG-NN drops that by fixed-T BPTT
q13_best_results: unknown
q14_unexplored: Behaviour beyond training T not reported in source we read

name: Implicit / infinite-depth GNNs (IGNN, EIGNN)
q1_graph: Fixed-point equilibrium of a graph recurrence (IGNN); closed-form linear solve (EIGNN)
q6_training: Implicit differentiation, projected gradient (IGNN); closed form (EIGNN)
q8_stability: Well-posedness via Perron-Frobenius conditions; shared contractive layers converge to a unique fixed point
q10_more_iterations_help: Infinite depth by construction; contractive fixed point means extra iterations add nothing after convergence
q13_best_results: Authors claim better long-range capture than baselines (unmatched)
q14_unexplored: Equilibrium GNN with learned/dynamic edges: not found in our search

name: IterGNN (iterative homogeneous GNN with learned termination)
q1_graph: Shared GNN body iterated; readout+MLP confidence decides termination
q7_scaling: Trained on sizes 4-33; tested to 5000 nodes
q10_more_iterations_help: Yes: 100% shortest path on 5000-node graphs; iterative module lifts ~60% to 100% at >=500 nodes; 100-layer fixed model worse
q13_best_results: Component counting 99.6% vs GCN 0.0% at larger sizes (unmatched)
q14_unexplored: Per-node (not global) learned halting combined with learned edges: not found in our search

name: Recurrent GNNs for algorithm learning (Grötschla et al.)
q1_graph: One recurrent GRU/GIN layer with edge convolution and skip connections, iterated
q6_training: Trained with 12 recurrent instances on size-10 graphs + L2 state regularization
q7_scaling: Tested to graphs 1,000x larger; 10x more rounds than training
q8_stability: Without L2 regularization accuracy collapses after ~100 rounds; stable to 10,000 rounds with it
q10_more_iterations_help: Yes, beyond horizon only with stabilizers; recurrence necessary but not sufficient
q13_best_results: RecGRU-E beats IterGNN and non-recurrent GIN (GIN cannot extrapolate); not param-matched
q14_unexplored: Same protocol vs a weight-shared looped transformer: not found in our search

name: GRAND (Graph Neural Diffusion)
q1_graph: Continuous diffusion PDE on graph; layers are time steps of a discretisation
q8_stability: Stability addressed for explicit and implicit schemes; maintains accuracy with layers while GCN degrades 50% after 4
q10_more_iterations_help: Depth maintained, not shown to improve capability
q13_best_results: Competitive on standard benchmarks (authors)

name: GraphCON and Gradient Gating (G2)
q1_graph: Second-order coupled-oscillator ODE over any GNN coupling (GraphCON); multi-rate gated GNN layers (G2)
q7_scaling: G2 Dirichlet energy stable to 1000 layers
q8_stability: Zero-energy steady states unstable (GraphCON); G2 proven to alleviate oversmoothing; GraphCON degrades after 64 layers on Cornell
q10_more_iterations_help: Small gains with depth: G2-GCN peaks at 128 layers; GraphCON-GCN improves up to 32
q13_best_results: unknown

name: Anti-Symmetric DGN (A-DGN)
q1_graph: ODE-discretised DGN with antisymmetric weights
q5_weight_sharing: Yes: weight sharing between layers (constant ODE params)
q8_stability: Proven stable and non-dissipative; no gradient vanishing/explosion
q13_best_results: unknown
q14_unexplored: Antisymmetric stabilization on a learned dynamic topology: not found in our search

name: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR)
q1_graph: Recurrence jointly on input graph and pooled hierarchical abstraction
q9_capacity: As little as 1% of SOTA parameters on long-range benchmarks
q10_more_iterations_help: Out-of-range generalization (distances > training) where 10-layer GIN fails
q13_best_results: Outperforms graph models on long-range benchmarks (unmatched)

q13_best_results: unknown

name: Neural Relational Inference (NRI)
q1_graph: VAE: GNN encoder infers discrete latent interaction graph; GNN decoder models dynamics
q13_best_results: Recovers ground-truth interactions unsupervised (authors)

name: Cooperative GNNs (Co-GNN)
year_venue: 2023 arXiv (venue not verified: OpenReview access failed)
q1_graph: Action network picks listen/broadcast/both/isolate per node per layer; environment network updates states
q2_edges: Input edges gated by state-conditioned actions; no new edges
q3_topology_at_inference: Yes, per layer from node and neighbour states
q7_scaling: Per-layer cost adds an action-network pass, linear in edges
q8_stability: Optimisation increasingly difficult with too many layers
q13_best_results: +3.19% roman-empire, +3.62% ROC AUC minesweeper vs best baseline (not explicitly matched)
q14_unexplored: Co-GNN made weight-tied and iterated with halting: not found in our search
